messages:
elaine: Auditor asked for proof of the full log chain for prod: app logs -> k8s audit -> S3 object store (retention + immutability) -> SIEM ingestion. They want sample exports, config snippets, a short control-mapping table, and a 1-paragraph narrative. Prefer one zip bundle. Need by EOD tomorrow, who can collect?

mike: I can grab Splunk/SIEM exports and forwarder configs. Our retention policy is 395 days for prod logs. Will export search results and include the forwarder config.

mike: Splunk query I'll export from the UI/api: 
```
index=redwood_prod sourcetype=app_logs earliest=-395d@d | stats count by host, source, _time | where source LIKE "%s3%" OR source LIKE "%k8s-audit%"
```
Export via API: 
```
curl -u me:TOKEN "https://splunk.internal/api/search/jobs/export" -d search="search index=redwood_prod ..." -o siem-export.csv
```

jordan: For the k8s side — we removed several cluster-admin bindings in Feb 2025 via PR #5874 (link in repo). Evidence to include: PR diff, approver list, kube-apiserver audit snippet that shows the rolebinding change, and the exact kubectl command run. To pull audit snippet: 
```
kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-apiserver-abc123 | grep -n "rolebinding" -A4 -B2 | sed -n '1,200p' > k8s-audit-snippet.txt
```
I will include the timestamped lines and the node + pod name so auditor can validate provenance.

lina: S3: audit-bundles bucket has Object Lock (governance) and versioning enabled. Retention window set to 395 days. I can export the object-lock configuration and a sample object's headers (ETag, x-amz-object-lock-retain-until-date, versionId). Command I will run: 
```
aws s3api get-object-lock-configuration --bucket redwood-audit-bundles > s3-lock-config.json
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-audit-bundles --key samples/ev-1995002468.zip > sample-object-meta.json
```
Will include the IAM principal that performed the export in the metadata.

sam: Auditor also wants separation-of-duties evidence for admin tasks. I'll assemble a small SoD mapping: repo owners vs infra admins vs on-call, with timestamps showing PR approvals and the deploy runbook steps. Will include screenshots of GitHub approvals + deploy pipeline run logs.

audit-bot: Evidence bundle created (draft): https://artifacts.internal/redwood/evidence/ev-1995002468-draft.zip (expires in 7 days) — contains: siem-export.csv, s3-lock-config.json, sample-object-meta.json, k8s-audit-snippet.txt, PR-5874-diff.patch, sod-mapping.xlsx, narrative.md.

elaine: Good start. @mike @jordan @lina @sam please add checksums (md5/sha256) and a short custody line (who exported, when, CLI host). Auditor will ask chain-of-custody questions. Can everyone confirm they will sign off by 09:00 UTC tomorrow?

mike: I will add md5/sha256 and the API user that ran the export.

jordan: I'll add the exact kubectl command, the apiserver pod name, and a copy of the shell history entry for provenance.

lina: Adding object ETag, versionId, and the IAM principal that ran the head-object call.

sam: I'll finish the control mapping narrative: SOC2 CC6.1 (change management), CC7 (logging/monitoring) and ISO A.12.4 mapping, plus a 1-paragraph explanation linking the artifacts to each control.

elaine: Nice. Once you each update, ping me and I'll assemble the final signed bundle and send to auditor. :thumbsup:
